visualCharacteristics.purpose: Separate white shadowed text note cards with a red-to-purple gradient bar on the left edge, optionally led by a small icon
visualCharacteristics.summary: White cards with square corners and a 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.24) shadow; a 12px vertical linear-gradient(#cc092f, #37398c) bar on the left edge; #535353 20px/27px 500 text, padding 0 92px 0 52px on desktop. Text-only cards sit 2 per row with 20px gaps and an odd last card spanning the full row; cards with an icon image sit one per row (full width) with a ~48px red line icon in a fixed column left of the text. Stacks to one column on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: One row per card. Text-only card: one rich-text cell (in UE the unset icon field leaves an empty first cell, which is dropped). Icon card: two cells, the icon image (UE fields image + imageAlt) then rich text

cells: Icon image (field image, alt in imageAlt)

Rich text (field text):

Note text with optional link

usage: Security page: three text-only account-protection notes (2-up with the third spanning) and three icon notes about phishing, suspicious calls and confidential information (one per row).
reuseGuidance: Use for short highlighted notices or callouts shown as separate shadowed cards with the gradient left bar. Leave the icon out for 2-up text notes (an odd last note spans the row); add an icon to render a full-width note with the icon on the left. Not for icon + heading + button tiles (use cards-icon) or photo cards (use cards).
